question.text: A submarine experiences a pressure of <math><mn>5.05</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></msup><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></math> at a depth of <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> in a sea. When it goes further to a depth of <math><mi> </mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> , it experiences a pressure of <math><mi> </mi><mn>8.08</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></msup><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></math> . Then <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>-</mo><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> is approximately (density of water <math><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></mrow><mo>/</mo><mrow><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mrow></math> and acceleration due to gravity <math><mi> </mi><mo>=</mo><mn>10</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math> ):

solution.text:
The pressure at a depth d is p=p0+ρgd, here p0 is the atmospheric pressure.
∴p1=p0+ρgd1
and p2=p0+ρgd2
The difference in pressure is p2-p1=ρgd2-d1

Putting the values in the above equation
8.08×106-5.05×106=103×10d2-d1
d2-d1=3.03×106104
=303 m
